headline: Crude bomb explodes beneath Agargaon metro station
summary: No casualties were reported after two individuals on a motorcycle threw a cocktail bomb at a water pump of the station.
details: A crude bomb, specifically a cocktail, exploded on top of a water pump beneath the Agargaon Metro Rail station in Dhaka.
The incident occurred around 9:30 PM on Monday night.
According to police sources, two individuals arrived on a motorcycle, threw the cocktail, and quickly fled the scene.
Inspector (Operation) Md. Masud Rana of the Sher-e-Bangla Nagar Police Station confirmed the explosion.
Fortunately, no one was injured or killed in the blast.
Police visited the site immediately after the explosion to investigate the incident.

Police visited the site immediately after the explosion to investigate the incident.

headline_marked: 800,000 seats: [[University seats may remain vacant]] after low HSC pass rate
headline: 800,000 seats: University seats may remain vacant after low HSC pass rate
summary: With only 52.12% of HSC students passing, Bangladesh's universities face a massive shortage of eligible candidates for the current academic year.
details: Around 800,000 university seats across Bangladesh could remain vacant this academic year. This follows a result where only 633,149 students passed the Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) and equivalent exams.
caption:
Nearly 800,000 university seats could stay empty this year. Why? Because just over half of the HSC candidates failed.

Around 800,000 university seats across Bangladesh could remain vacant this academic year. This follows a result where only 633,149 students passed the Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) and equivalent exams.
